# Sugar High client-side screenshot tool

Open `/capture` with base64url-encoded state in the URL fragment:

`/capture#code=<base64url-utf8>&lang=<language>&theme=<light|dark>&filename=<name>&width=<320-1200>`

The fragment is decoded entirely in the browser and is not sent to the server.

Agent workflow:

1. Base64url-encode the UTF-8 source code without padding.
2. Open the capture URL in a browser.
3. Wait until `[data-sugar-high-capture="ready"]` exists.
4. Screenshot that same `[data-sugar-high-capture="ready"]` element.

JavaScript is the default language. Language names, aliases, and file extensions supported by
Sugar High are accepted. Invalid values fall back to JavaScript, light mode, and a width of 640px.
